newsitem.title: BELGIUM: HEIDELBERGER HOLDS 50.01 PCT CBR - BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: HEIDELBERGER HOLDS 50.01 PCT CBR - BOURSE.

text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange said on Thursday German cement group Heidelberger Zement AG had notified the bourse it had increased its stake in Belgian unit CBR to 50.01 percent by October 7.

The last time Heidelberger published a transparency statement about its CBR holding in June 1994 it held 45.30 percent of the Belgian company, the bourse said in a statement on its electronic message system.
CBR has been the most actively traded stock on the Brussels bourse for the last two days amid speculation ahead of the expiry in December of put warrants on its shares.

Each of the warrants, issued by Heidelberger in 1993 when it bought 42.4 percent of CBR from Societe Generale de Belgique, allows holders to sell five CBR shares for 11,750 francs, or 2,350 francs a share.

CBR rose slightly following Heidelberger's announcement. The share was at 2,385 francs, up 30 on the day, compared with 2,380 francs shortly before the announcement. A large 260,958 shares had been traded, after 210,012 shares were traded on Wednesday.

Heidelberger has said in the past that it wanted to increase its CBR stake to over 50 percent in order to fully consolidate its interest. However, it is believed the German group does not want to acquire much more of the company.
